description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI_Email_SimpleCheck, which provides a simple email validation method based on a regular expression. It extends another class, HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI_Email, and implements a validate function to check email address formats.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI_Email_SimpleCheck
classes.description: A class for validating email addresses using a regular expression, extending the base email validation class.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the provided email string against a regex pattern, returning the string if valid or false if invalid.
